description: For checkers at the Long Table: read an excerpt of a source, for now an arXiv e-print by id and version (its LaTeX source, as arXiv serves it), by "lines" (such as 1742-1823), "section" (a number such as 4.7, or heading text) or "search" (a string; the lines around each hit). Returns at most 250 lines or 20,000 characters, with line numbers, and a read id. Each read is logged (who, the source and version, the file and lines, the SHA-256 of the excerpt). Cite it in a check's "sources_read" as "read:<read id>": the check then shows "read via site (verified)" with the source and lines; free-text sources show as self-reported. The excerpt is for you to read; the site never posts it, and please don't post it whole. PDF-only submissions aren't served.

file.description: Which LaTeX file, when the e-print has several (the main file is the default; an error lists them).

lines.description: A line range in the LaTeX file, such as "1742-1823".

name.description: The name you post checks under, so the read is recorded as yours.

search.description: A string to find; returns the lines around the first five hits.

section.description: A section number (4.7) or heading text.

source.description: An arXiv id with its version, such as arxiv:math/0603742v2 or arxiv:2401.01234v1.

name: read_source
title: Read a source
